title: Domestic publicly offered open-ended fund data, rights, and paper-test feasibility

research_hurdle_policy.five_percent: A long-run research hurdle only; not a guarantee, minimum return, or product promise.
research_hurdle_policy.distribution_policy: No distribution or reinvestment requirement is imposed. Actual distributions, if any, must be handled under the contemporaneous fund documents and share-class rules in a future total-return calculation.

conclusion.summary: Regulatory disclosure creates a plausible product-level primary-source path, but the present case has neither a validated historical point-in-time universe nor a rights-cleared total-return, fee, and operability data package. It is therefore not a usable strategy and not eligible for a return test.
conclusion.public_path: A pre-frozen, limited universe could in principle be reconstructed from retained primary disclosures after version, timestamp, and terms-of-use checks. This is not evidence that a complete or bulk-downloadable historical archive is available.
conclusion.licensed_path: Wind, Choice, and iFinD are identified as candidate licensable sources only. No contract, data dictionary, delivery sample, coverage proof, or retention/export right has been obtained.

source_records.title: 公开募集证券投资基金信息披露管理办法
facts_used: Specified websites include fund manager, custodian, and CSRC fund electronic disclosure websites.
Specified websites should provide fund disclosure service free of charge.
Open-end funds disclose unit NAV and accumulated NAV no later than the next day after each open day.
Subscription/redemption calculation method and fees must be stated in fund disclosure documents.
source_records.rights_boundary: Public investor access and copying of disclosure materials do not themselves establish rights for bulk extraction, database redistribution, or long-term programmatic storage.

source_records.title: 公开募集证券投资基金运作管理办法
facts_used: Fund contracts and prospectuses must state open days and times.
Subscription/redemption prices use the applicable open-day NAV plus or minus fees; NAV is calculated after the open-day close.
Confirmation normally occurs within three working days and valid redemption payment within seven working days, subject to special products.
Large redemptions may be deferred or payment delayed under the rule and fund documents.
The regulation distinguishes stock, bond, money market, FOF, and mixed funds by investment proportions.
Open-end fund distributions are governed by the fund contract.
source_records.rights_boundary: Regulatory mechanics do not establish an individual's account eligibility, channel availability, or historical execution capability.

source_records.title: 中国证监会基金信息披露网站于2009年7月20日正式上线
facts_used: CSRC stated that fund daily NAV and periodic-report XBRL documents were displayed through the fund disclosure website.
The announcement states that daily NAV XBRL documents were reported from 2009-01-01.
source_records.rights_boundary: The announcement supports the existence and intended public use of a disclosure channel, not the current completeness, bulk access, or reuse rights of every historical file.
source_records.access_check: Direct machine fetch of the endpoint timed out on 2026-08-15; this is not treated as evidence of absence or availability.

source_records.title: 货币市场基金监督管理办法（中国证券监督管理委员会令第120号）
facts_used: Money market fund valuation and liquidity measures differ from ordinary open-end funds.
Specified stress conditions can trigger a mandatory redemption fee and rules may permit deferred redemption handling or payment delay.
source_records.rights_boundary: This rule establishes risk and mechanics conditions; it does not supply a complete historical money-market-fund return or execution dataset.

source_records.title: 中国基金业协会公募基金市场统计及产品查询入口
facts_used: AMAC provides monthly public-fund market statistics and a product-query service entry.
source_records.rights_boundary: The reviewed pages do not prove a historic daily public-fund constituent archive, inactive-product coverage, or share-class event history.

source_records.title: Wind data services and fund research platform
facts_used: Wind publicly describes FTP, Filesync, API, and other data-delivery modes and fund-data coverage.
source_records.rights_boundary: Candidate licensable source only. Exact fund fields, historic coverage, retained-data rights, and redistribution limits must be confirmed in writing before use.

source_records.title: Choice data services and end-user license agreement
facts_used: Choice publicly advertises financial terminal and data-API products.
The published user agreement indicates that product use is subject to contractual terms.
source_records.rights_boundary: Candidate licensable source only. No proof exists in this case for the required fund fields, historical revision policy, API/export scope, or reproducible internal-research right.

source_records.title: 同花顺数据接口
facts_used: The public page describes support for funds and historical market-data interfaces.
source_records.rights_boundary: Candidate licensable source only. It does not establish that the relevant open-end fund NAV, distributions, status events, fees, and retention rights are included.
source_records.access_check: Search-result content reviewed on 2026-08-15; direct page machine fetch timed out.

source_records.title: 天天基金开放式基金净值表
facts_used: The page displays fund codes, NAV fields, subscription/redemption status, and fee fields and identifies Choice as a source.
source_records.rights_boundary: The page itself says its information is for reference and should be verified. It is retained only as a weak display-field cross-check, not as a primary total-return, universe, or rights source.

field_readiness.field: Point-in-time universe, share classes, inception, closure, merger, and code/name history
field_readiness.candidate_source: Licensed fund master/status data plus primary-announcement verification
field_readiness.gap: No historic daily universe or inactive-product proof has been obtained.

field_readiness.field: Non-money-market daily unit NAV, accumulated NAV, disclosure time, and availability time
field_readiness.candidate_source: CSRC electronic disclosure, fund manager/custodian disclosures, licensed data
field_readiness.gap: Disclosure obligations are verified but continuous data, timestamps, revisions, and rights are not.

field_readiness.field: Money-market daily income, annualized-yield fields, holiday treatment, and valuation convention
field_readiness.candidate_source: Money-market income notices, legal documents, licensed data
field_readiness.gap: No normalized historical income and event package exists in this case.

field_readiness.field: Distributions, splits, conversions, liquidation, and total-return adjustment
field_readiness.candidate_source: Primary notices plus licensed corporate-action or total-return data
field_readiness.gap: Unit NAV, accumulated NAV, and investor total return cannot be presumed equivalent.

field_readiness.field: Historical fund and investor-facing fee schedules
field_readiness.candidate_source: Dated legal documents, rate-change notices, and a licensed historical fee table
field_readiness.gap: Current web rates and platform discounts cannot be used to backfill historical costs.

field_readiness.field: Subscription/redemption availability, cutoff, confirmation, payment, limits, suspension, and stress handling
field_readiness.candidate_source: Fund documents, announcements, sales/registration data, and historical status events
field_readiness.gap: General regulations do not provide fund- and channel-specific historical operability.

field_readiness.field: Internal research storage, export/API, reproducibility, and source version
field_readiness.candidate_source: Written vendor license and retained original files
field_readiness.gap: No rights-cleared data contract or data package exists.

required_controls: daily income rather than a substituted ordinary-NAV series
stress redemption fee and deferral rules

gates.name: Point-in-time universe
gates.pass_evidence: Dated universe snapshots or a licensed master file including inactive funds, share-class changes, closures, mergers, and status history.

gates.name: Continuous NAV/income history
gates.pass_evidence: Source-labelled daily series with disclosure/availability timestamps, revisions, and missing-data rules; money-market series separate.

gates.name: Total return and distributions
gates.pass_evidence: Recomputable adjusted return or dated distribution, split, conversion, fee, and field-definition records by share class.

gates.name: Fees and operability
gates.pass_evidence: Effective-dated rate and status history for subscription, redemption, conversion, holding period, cutoff, confirmation, payment, suspension, and limits.

gates.name: Data rights and reproducibility
gates.pass_evidence: Written permission or documented primary-file rights covering internal research, retention, export/API, source version, and reproducible hashes.

gates.name: Pre-frozen rulebook and independent recomputation
gates.pass_evidence: A rulebook frozen before results, including universe, signal, timing, costs, missing-data treatment, and stop conditions, then independently recomputed.

next_gate.name: Data rights and sample acceptance
next_gate.purpose: Internal data diligence only; it does not choose a fund or determine an investment action.
requirements: Written vendor terms for internal research, storage, reproducible export/API, duration, redistribution restrictions, sources, and revision policy.
A sample demonstrating historic point-in-time universe coverage, including inactive funds and share-class/state events.
Daily NAV or money-market income, distributions/splits/conversions, disclosure and availability timestamps, revision and missingness status by share class.
Cross-check of a non-selected sample against original legal documents, notices, and NAV disclosures.
Independent recomputation from retained raw export, source hashes, and an exception log.
next_gate.pass_outcome: May enter a rule-pre-frozen paper-test design stage only; it does not establish performance, liquidity, suitability, or strategy admission.
next_gate.fail_outcome: Remain not_testable with no product selection, no return calculation, and no action.

prohibited_inferences: A disclosure obligation does not prove complete, bulk-accessible, rights-cleared historical data.
A displayed NAV, fee, or open status does not prove a person's eligibility, ability to transact, or execution price.
Unit NAV, accumulated NAV, and investor total return must not be treated as interchangeable without field definitions and dated event records.
No strategy performance, hurdle satisfaction, allocation, or action may be inferred before all gates pass.
no_action_boundary: No account, suitability, or sales-channel action is authorized.
No subscription, redemption, conversion, transfer, payment, or external transaction is authorized.
No data purchase or external contact is authorized by this memo.
